items.label: MA-AG civil: Exeter Finance LLC
items.detail: Assurance of discontinuance filed in Suffolk Superior Court over financing of unfair subprime auto loans; date is the announcement date. Release says Exeter will pay more than $5.5 million: $4.675 million for borrower relief plus $825000 to the state (stated floor, entered as 5500000). Delaware AG announced a separate settlement the same day. Cash-only rule applied 2026-10-11: amount changed from 5,500,000 to 825,000; the part not counted is listed in data/manual/excluded-amounts.csv as xa-013.

excluded_amounts.reason: Release: the settlement "includes $4.675 million that will be available to provide relief to harmed borrowers and an $825,000 payment to the state"; Exeter "will also waive deficiencies" (not valued). The release does not say whether the $4.675 million is paid in cash or applied to loans. Counted: the $825,000 payment. Owner decision 2026-10-11: kept out of the totals because the release does not state the cash part; revisit if a release or order states it.
excluded_amounts.category_label: Split not stated by the source (cash from relief, or between payers)
